panels.shot: Grey dawn. Firemen carry a covered stretcher. A burned hand hangs out, wearing Bell's gold signet ring. Nero sniffs the hand, then turns away calmly.

lines.text: They said it was Bell. The ring said so. The dog said nothing.

panels.shot: Close-up. The hero's hands hold a half-burned ledger page: Debt of L. Malaspina: 4,000,000. Transferred to the man who broke the club. Collector: S. Marchetti, Pier 9.

lines.text: Underworld rule: break a man, inherit his debts. They had sent me the bill.

panels.shot: The hero pulls the silver tuning fork out of the charred door frame. Rain runs down his face. Nero sits beside him, ears up.
A payphone on the corner rings. The hero picks it up. Cut-in: a man in a trench coat in a phone booth across town, face hidden by a hat brim (Inspector Hale).

lines.speaker: Hale · phone
lines.text: The fork means the Choir. Start at Pier 9. And keep your head down.
